meta.title: Add Claude CLI support with Strategy Pattern architecture (v0.6.0)
meta.body_summary: Adds Claude CLI support with Strategy Pattern refactor, claiming reduced hasClaudeCLI() calls from 4 to 1 per operation for performance improvement.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code added CLI support with strategy refactor claiming call count reduction; PR open with no reviews.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 458 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. As a performance-focused architectural change with no review yet, it remains open without a decision.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduces hasClaudeCLI() calls from 4 per installation operation to 1 per server startup.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully restructured the installer with Strategy Pattern and added new CLI support, a medium-complexity architectural change. The performance claim is stated but unverified, and the PR remains open without maintainer engagement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Performance claim is only narrative; no benchmark, profiler, or CI evaluation data.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored MCP installer from conditional branching to Strategy Pattern, adding InstallationStrategy interface with ClaudeCliStrategy and ClaudeDesktopStrategy. Moved hasClaudeCLI() detection to server startup to reduce redundant calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README updated with installation docs; package.json bumped to 0.6.1; package-lock.json updated; local Claude config added.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Add Claude CLI detection and install functions; update README.
Remove unused function to fix TypeScript compilation.
Refactor with Strategy Pattern, eliminating duplicate hasClaudeCLI() calls.
Bump version to 0.6.0 and later to 0.6.1.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Claude_Code with 6 commits, no human interaction yet.
